_description: SentinelOne Singularity EDR threats + audit-log → AKSI control mapping. SentinelOne Singularity (parallel to CrowdStrike Falcon) ships an AI-driven, behavior-centric detection model with autonomous mitigation and an explicit ``AI Threat`` classification axis distinct from Falcon's MITRE-tactic vocabulary. Threats arrive as ``threats[]`` records with ``threatInfo`` (severity ``E_CRITICAL|E_HIGH|E_MEDIUM|E_LOW``, ``analystVerdict``, ``confidenceLevel``, ``incidentStatus``, ``classification``, ``mitigationStatus``, ``engines[]``), ``agentRealtimeInfo`` (computer name, domain, OS, machine type, infected/active flags, version), ``behavioralIndicators[]``, ``automatedResponses`` (actionsTaken, approvalRequired, approvedBy, is_authenticated_response), binary signature/path metadata, kill-chain position, and origin geo. Audit events arrive as ``audit_logs[]`` with ``action`` (site_settings_changed, policy_changed, user_role_changed, api_token_created, agent_uninstalled, deep_visibility_query) and an ``actor`` block. Severity routing: E_CRITICAL + open → DE-01 FAIL; E_CRITICAL + resolved/true_positive → PR-05 FAIL (audit trail of confirmed); E_CRITICAL + false_positive → PR-05 PASS; E_HIGH + open → DE-01 FAIL. Classification taxonomy: Ransomware → DE-01 FAIL → BLOCK (top priority); ``Supply Chain`` → DE-01 FAIL (relevant to AI-generated code); ``AI Threat`` → DE-01 FAIL (S1's AI-specific class); Malware/Trojan/Worm/Rootkit/Backdoor at High/Critical → DE-01 FAIL. behavioralIndicators map directly: DataExfiltration → PR-04, CredentialDumping → PR-01, LateralMovement → PR-02, CommandAndControl → DE-01, ProcessInjection → PR-03. Binary integrity: invalid signature (non-PUA) → DE-01 FAIL; unsigned binary in system path → PR-04 FAIL. Autonomous-response governance: kill_process/quarantine/disconnect/disable_user with approvalRequired=true and approvedBy=null → PR-02 FAIL (autonomous high-impact action without approval); kill/disable_user with is_authenticated_response=false → PR-02 FAIL; low confidence + non-empty actionsTaken → PR-03 FLAG. Agent posture: agentInfected=true → DE-01 FAIL; agentIsActive=false on production-named host → PR-02 FAIL (protection gap); mitigationStatus=marked_as_benign on Malware/Ransomware/AI Threat → PR-02 FAIL (silencing critical detection). kill_chain_position=exfiltration → PR-04 FAIL. Audit log routing: site_settings_changed disabling protection → PR-02 FAIL; policy_changed weakening detection → PR-02 FLAG; user_role_changed to admin → PR-02 FLAG; api_token_created → PR-01 FLAG; agent_uninstalled by non-admin → PR-02 FAIL (rogue removal); deep_visibility_query → captured.
